decisions.subject: Production pipeline

options_considered.label: animated-explainer
options_considered.reason: Channel default in channels/ky-chu-phap-luat/channel.yaml; supports research-first Legal Dossier workflow, Remotion composition, fact_whitelist_gate, and editorial QC gates.

options_considered.label: animation
options_considered.reason: Built for Ink Theater / character-led stories rather than factual legal explainers.
options_considered.rejected_because: Does not fit Legal Dossier editorial briefing structure.

options_considered.label: documentary-montage
options_considered.reason: Requires existing archival video footage as primary backbone.
options_considered.rejected_because: Channel intro centers on structured diagrams, 2 modes, 6 pillars, and 3-layer verification.

decisions.reason: Matches channel SSOT default_pipeline and editorial QC gates.

decisions.subject: Style playbook and channel visual theme

options_considered.label: archival-editorial (theme: ky-chu-phap-luat Legal Dossier)
options_considered.reason: Channel SSOT playbook: Warm Gazette Paper #F6F2E9, Statutory Navy #0D1B2A, Legal Forest Green #145A4A, Seal Crimson #B91C1C, Brass Gold #C58B16/#F2C94C, Barlow Condensed + Plus Jakarta Sans, 35mm 12fps grain, TikTok Safe Zone v3.2.

options_considered.label: clean-professional
options_considered.reason: Generic corporate clean style without Vietnamese Legal Dossier identity.

options_considered.label: flat-motion-graphics
options_considered.reason: High-saturation flat social style.
options_considered.rejected_because: Lacks the authority and archival trust of Legal Dossier.

decisions.reason: Preserves ky-chu-phap-luat channel visual contract and Safe Zone v3.2.

decisions.subject: Composition render runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion (React + spring physics + Safe Zone v3.2 + KcplBumper9x16)
options_considered.reason: Available on machine; powers existing ky-chu-phap-luat theme, word-level burned-in captions, EditorialMap/FlowTimeline/ComparisonSplit motion, and KcplBumper9x16 outro.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: HTML/CSS/GSAP runtime for bespoke kinetic web-style compositions.
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine (disabled in config.yaml: runtimes.hyperframes.enabled: false)

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only (Ken Burns / concat)
options_considered.reason: Always available locally for simple video concat/trim.
options_considered.rejected_because: Cannot render React Legal Dossier diagrams, spring transitions, or Safe Zone v3.2 word-level TikTok captions.

decisions.reason: Remotion is available and natively integrates ky-chu-phap-luat theme, Safe Zone v3.2 captions, and KcplBumper9x16; HyperFrames is disabled on this machine.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Atelier (hand-authored bespoke scenes using kyChuPhapLuatTheme mechanics)
options_considered.reason: Channel intro is a flagship pinned video; custom bespoke Legal Dossier scenes avoid repetitive stock card look while keeping Safe Zone v3.2 and channel theme.

options_considered.label: Templated (stock Explainer cut.type cards)
options_considered.reason: Faster assembly using generic stock cut types.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less distinctive for a flagship channel intro pinned at the top of the TikTok profile.

decisions.reason: Flagship channel intro warrants bespoke Legal Dossier visual storytelling.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: VieNeu TTS (local 48kHz Vietnamese, speed 1.1, channel tts_lexicon.json)
options_considered.reason: Configured channel default in channels/ky-chu-phap-luat/channel.yaml; native Vietnamese 48kHz voiceover, $0.00 cost, integrates tts_lexicon.json.

options_considered.label: OpenAI TTS (API)
options_considered.reason: Cloud API fallback ($0.05-0.15), less natural Vietnamese legal pronunciation than VieNeu.
options_considered.rejected_because: VieNeu local 48kHz is natively tuned for Vietnamese news/legal channels and free.

decisions.reason: Native 48kHz Vietnamese narration matching channel SSOT at zero cost.

decisions.subject: Background music track

options_considered.label: Channel BGM: data-and-systems.m4a (2:55, ~92 BPM, modular synth + piano ostinato)
options_considered.reason: Explicitly indexed in channels/ky-chu-phap-luat/assets/bgm/README.md for calm, authoritative explanation of legal articles and life-law series.

options_considered.label: Channel BGM: editorial-edge.m4a (2:58, ~106 BPM)
options_considered.reason: Higher urgency groove suited for breaking decrees/penalties.
options_considered.rejected_because: Slightly too urgent for a welcoming channel introduction.

options_considered.label: Channel BGM: tech-news-broadcast-bed.m4a (2:56, ~114 BPM)
options_considered.reason: Fast news roundup bed.
options_considered.rejected_because: Better suited to multi-item daily news digests.

options_considered.label: Royalty-free search via pixabay_music
options_considered.reason: Available backup if user wants a different mood.
options_considered.rejected_because: Channel already has curated BGM beds mixed for voiceover headroom.

options_considered.label: No background music
options_considered.reason: Dry narration only.
options_considered.rejected_because: Reduces TikTok retention and channel polish.

decisions.reason: Calm, credible ~92 BPM bed specifically matched in channel BGM README for legal breakdowns.

decisions.subject: Channel intro concept option

options_considered.label: Công Báo Thu Nhỏ — Mở Hồ Sơ Ký Chủ Pháp Luật (Problem-Solution, 75s)
options_considered.reason: Addresses viewer distrust of clipped TikTok legal rumors upfront, then clearly unpacks 2 content modes, 6 series pillars (30 topics), 5 official portals, and 3-layer verification.

options_considered.label: 60 Giây Pháp Luật Qua 3 Cửa Kiểm Chứng Thế Nào? (Journey, 65s)
options_considered.reason: Leads with behind-the-scenes verification rigor; strong authority but less warm as a first-impression welcome.

options_considered.label: 30 Tình Huống Luật Đời Sống — Bạn Đã Gặp Mấy Chuyện? (Data Narrative, 80s)
options_considered.reason: Very relatable everyday hooks first, then introduces channel modes and verification.

decisions.reason: Recommended default pending user choice: best balance of hook, full roadmap, and verification proof.
